base_solution_anchor.base_sql:
SELECT (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM foreign_data WHERE XCL_077='Spanish')*100.0/(SELECT COUNT(*) FROM cards) AS percentage, c.XCL_003 AS name
FROM cards c
JOIN foreign_data f ON f.XCL_082 = c.XCL_072
WHERE f.XCL_077='Spanish'
